title: Climate variability and flow management impact phytoplankton biomass in a shallow reservoir
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00094G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Danielle S. Spence, Kristin J. Painter, Ali Nazemi, Jason J. Venkiteswaran, Helen M. Baulch
This study shows that climate oscillations and changing flow sources impact bloom dynamics in a shallow reservoir. These changes in bloom dynamics have important implications for drinking water treatment and key lessons for water management.
